task: Wolfram check that GKD (Revision/gkd_lovelock/code/src/gkd.rs) is the author's kδ, and exact recomputation of the Lovelock tensors P_(k), A_(k), k = 1, 2, 3, of (4.38) for the author's 8D test metric with the verbatim kδ
authorDefinition: kδ[lower_, upper_] /; Length[lower] == Length[upper] := Det[Outer[delta, lower, upper]]

gkdValuesSource.how: values computed by the compiled Rust function lovelock_gkd::gkd::GKD (crate Revision/gkd_lovelock/code, unchanged, as a path dependency) through the exporter whose source is embedded in this script (exporterMainRs), built with cargo in the export directory ($LOVELOCK_GKD_EXPORT_DIR, default <$TemporaryDirectory>/revision_gkd_export); the GKD rule is not re-implemented in Wolfram Language
gkdValuesSource.recordLayout: signed bytes: p, lower_1..lower_p, upper_1..upper_p, GKD(lower, upper); labels 0..7

verbatimKDeltaUse: GKD comparison: the verbatim kδ is called on every one of the 346304 pairs
k = 1: every 1-tuple of the 156 nonzero R^ab_cd for each of the 64 components (9984 calls), no skip
k = 2: every 2-tuple of the 156 nonzero R^ab_cd for each of the 64 components (1557504 calls), no skip

k = 3, all 64 components: an R entry whose upper (lower) index pair repeats a label already in the lower (upper) row of kδ is skipped (two equal rows or columns of Outer[delta, lower, upper], so the determinant is 0); the verbatim kδ is called on every one of the 1128960 index lists that are left
no faster equivalent of kδ (Signature, permutation sign, Levi-Civita product) is used anywhere
notRead: no Mathematica notebook (.nb file) of the author, not Generalized_Kronecker_Delta.txt, no other file with the author's answers; the definition of kδ is re-typed from PROVENANCE_OF_THE_COMPUTATION.md, the metric from the task
timesNote: run times are printed on standard output (time_<step>=<seconds>), not stored here, so that two runs give byte-identical reports

checks.name: definition_is_the_authors_verbatim

checks.name: definition_unequal_lengths_stay_unevaluated
